description:
Reusable worker configuration.

All fields are flat (no nesting).  Optional fields (``timeout_seconds``,
``max_context_tokens``, etc.) default to ``None``, meaning the value is
inherited from the spawning session at spawn time.

name.description: Unique name for this worker definition.
name.title: Name

description.description: Human-readable description of what this worker does.
description.title: Description

system_prompt.description: System prompt used to initialise the worker agent.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

tools.description: List of tool names this worker is allowed to call.
tools.title: Tools

permission_footprint.description: Permission categories required by this worker, e.g. ``{"filesystem": "read"}``.
permission_footprint.title: Permission Footprint

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time for a single worker turn.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the worker's conversation context.
max_context_tokens.title: Max Context Tokens

warning_threshold_tokens.description: Token count at which the worker emits a warning.
warning_threshold_tokens.title: Warning Threshold Tokens

turn_limit.description: Maximum number of turns before the worker stops.
turn_limit.title: Turn Limit

temperature.description: LLM temperature override for this worker.
temperature.title: Temperature

title: WorkerDefinition
